stem:
The graph shows the amount of money earned by an employee based on the time he spent working.

Which list shows the dependent quantities in the graph?
visual_elements: scatter plot with x-axis labeled 'Time Spent Working (hours)' from 0 to 7 and y-axis labeled 'Amount Earned (dollars)' from 0 to 50, points at (1,10), (2,20), (3,30), (4,40), (5,50)
